prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your goals. Do you need brand strategy, digital/SEO, paid media, physician recruitment, consumer patient acquisition, or enterprise-level agency-side services for a hospital or device company? Budget, timeline, and whether you want a local firm versus a national agency that will support St. Louis also matter.

To help now, here’s a quick, practical approach and next step I can take for you:

1) Quick criteria to pick the best agency for your situation
- Healthcare experience: proven work with hospitals, clinics, health systems, pharma, medical devices, or telehealth.
- Regulatory/compliance knowledge: HIPAA, FDA/FTC rules, patient privacy.
- Measurable outcomes: case studies showing leads, conversions, patient volume, ROI.
- Channels & capabilities: content/SEO, paid search/social, creative, CRM/EMR integrations, analytics.
- Industry credibility: awards, healthcare-specific certifications, client references.
- Fit: team size, culture, reporting cadence, pricing model.

2) Process to identify the right partner
- Define 2–3 primary objectives (e.g., increase new patient volume 20% in 12 months).
- Ask for case studies and KPIs; get references.
- Run a small paid pilot or discovery project before long-term commitment.
- Check contract terms for exclusivity, IP, and performance guarantees.

3) If you want a shortlist
I can compile a short list (3–5) of highly rated St. Louis agencies with healthcare experience, including recent case studies and estimated pricing ranges. Do you want that? If yes, tell me:
- Which services you need (SEO, PPC, creative, PR, recruitment, etc.)
- Approximate monthly budget or project budget
- Whether you prefer a strictly local agency or are open to national agencies that work with St. Louis clients

Tell me those details and I’ll generate a tailored shortlist and recommendation.
